Action for Community Development (ACD) is a Cameroonian civil society organisation that promotes the governance and sustainable management of natural resources, the rights of local and indigenous communities and the protection of the environment.

Action for Community Development is a civil society organisation that promotes sustainable and inclusive governance and management of natural resources, the promotion and protection of the rights of local and indigenous communities whose livelihoods depend on the exploitation of natural resources, and the protection of the environment.
